1.Name: Bulbasaur
1.Pokedex: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.

2.Name: Ivysaur
2.Pokedex: To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.

3.Name: Venusaur
3.Pokedex: Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. A strong aroma wafts from it.

4.Name: Charmander
4.Pokedex: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

5.Name: Charmeleon
5.Pokedex: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

6.Name: Charizard
6.Pokedex: A Charizard flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.

7.Name: Squirtle
7.Pokedex: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.

8.Name: Wartortle
8.Pokedex: It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For fast swimming, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

9.Name: Blastoise
9.Pokedex: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel. Its water spouts are very accurate.

10.Name: Caterpie
10.Pokedex: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.

11.Name: Metapod
11.Pokedex: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

12.Name: Butterfree
12.Pokedex: It uses telepathy to seek, extract, and carry delicious honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

13.Name: Weedle
13.Pokedex: A Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis.

14.Name: Kakuna
14.Pokedex: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.

15.Name: Beedrill
15.Pokedex: A Beedrill is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack all-out.

16.Name: Pidgey
16.Pokedex: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.

17.Name: Pidgeotto
17.Pokedex: This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the interloper.

18.Name: Pidgeot
18.Pokedex: This Pokémon has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many trainers are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.

19.Name: Orthwyrm
19.Pokedex: It launches fists from its segmented tendrils. Downcast among dragons, it has been driven out to cold, dark, isolated environments.

20.Name: Barnakanua
20.Pokedex: Barnakanua's legs and hands have minds of their own and can act independently. Its head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

21.Name: Spearow
21.Pokedex: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

22.Name: Fearow
22.Pokedex: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.

23.Name: Ekans
23.Pokedex: An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.

24.Name: Arbok
24.Pokedex: This Pokémon has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.

25.Name: Pikachu
25.Pokedex: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.

26.Name: Raichu
26.Pokedex: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.

27.Name: Sandshrew
27.Pokedex: Sandshrew has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The Pokémon can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.

28.Name: Sandslash
28.Pokedex: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly rolling, scurrying, climbing, and digging.

29.Name: Nidoran
29.Pokedex: Although not very combative, it will rake its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

30.Name: Nidorina
30.Pokedex: It has a calm and caring nature. When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body.

31.Name: Nidoqueen
31.Pokedex: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

32.Name: Nidoran
32.Pokedex: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

33.Name: Nidorino
33.Pokedex: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

34.Name: Nidoking
34.Pokedex: A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

35.Name: Clefairy
35.Pokedex: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.

36.Name: Clefable
36.Pokedex: A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.

37.Name: Vulpix
37.Pokedex: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o'-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

38.Name: Ninetales
38.Pokedex: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that shines like gold.

39.Name: Jigglypuff
39.Pokedex: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a Jigglypuff's song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

40.Name: Wigglytuff
40.Pokedex: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

41.Name: Zubat
41.Pokedex: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.

42.Name: Golbat
42.Pokedex: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokémon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

43.Name: Oddish
43.Pokedex: This Pokémon grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.

44.Name: Gloom
44.Pokedex: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.

45.Name: Vileplume
45.Pokedex: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a Vileplume turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.

46.Name: Paras
46.Pokedex: A Paras has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.

47.Name: Parasect
47.Pokedex: Parasect are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.

48.Name: Venonat
48.Pokedex: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. They act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

49.Name: Venomoth
49.Pokedex: Venomoth are nocturnal--they only are active at night. The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

50.Name: Diglett
50.Pokedex: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.

51.Name: Dugtrio
51.Pokedex: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.

52.Name: Meowth
52.Pokedex: Meowth withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

53.Name: Persian
53.Pokedex: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

54.Name: Psyduck
54.Pokedex: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.

55.Name: Golduck
55.Pokedex: A Golduck is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.

56.Name: Mankey
56.Pokedex: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign of anger. Since this happens instantly, however, there is no time to flee.

57.Name: Primeape
57.Pokedex: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.

58.Name: Growlithe
58.Pokedex: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

59.Name: Arcanine
59.Pokedex: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

60.Name: Poliwag
60.Pokedex: It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

61.Name: Poliwhirl
61.Pokedex: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.

62.Name: Poliwrath
62.Pokedex: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This Pokémon can swim back and forth across the ocean without effort.

63.Name: Abra
63.Pokedex: A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses Teleport to change its location once every hour.

64.Name: Kadabra
64.Pokedex: An urban legend suggests a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.

65.Name: Alakazam
65.Pokedex: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.

66.Name: Machop
66.Pokedex: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

67.Name: Machoke
67.Pokedex: A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.

68.Name: Machamp
68.Pokedex: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.

69.Name: Bellsprout
69.Pokedex: A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.

70.Name: Weepinbell
70.Pokedex: At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.

71.Name: Victreebel
71.Pokedex: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.

72.Name: Tentacool
72.Pokedex: Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This Pokémon shoots beams from the small round organ above its eyes.

73.Name: Tentacruel
73.Pokedex: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.

74.Name: Geodude
74.Pokedex: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.

75.Name: Graveler
75.Pokedex: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.

76.Name: Golem
76.Pokedex: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.

77.Name: Ponyta
77.Pokedex: A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.

78.Name: Rapidash
78.Pokedex: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a Rapidash turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

79.Name: Slowpoke
79.Pokedex: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.

80.Name: Slowbro
80.Pokedex: Its tail has a shell firmly attached. Naturally dull to begin with, Slowbro lose their ability to feel pain after evolving.

81.Name: Magnemite
81.Pokedex: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 100 meters away.

82.Name: Magneton
82.Pokedex: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.

83.Name: Farfetch'd
83.Pokedex: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.

84.Name: Doduo
84.Pokedex: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

85.Name: Dodrio
85.Pokedex: A peculiar Pokémon species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.

86.Name: Seel
86.Pokedex: Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

87.Name: Dewgong
87.Pokedex: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on glaciers has mistakenly been thought to be a mermaid by mariners in ancient times.

88.Name: Grimer
88.Pokedex: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.

89.Name: Muk
89.Pokedex: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making Muk reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

90.Name: Shellder
90.Pokedex: At night, it burrows a hole in the cold seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

91.Name: Cloyster
91.Pokedex: It swims in cold seas by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.

92.Name: Gastly
92.Pokedex: When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.

93.Name: Haunter
93.Pokedex: If a Haunter beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don't approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.

94.Name: Gengar
94.Pokedex: Even your home isn't safe. Gengar will lurk in whatever dark corner of a room it can find and wait for its chance to catch its prey.

95.Name: Onix
95.Pokedex: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an Onix from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

96.Name: Drowzee
96.Pokedex: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.

97.Name: Hypno
97.Pokedex: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a Hypno's hand lulls the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

98.Name: Krabby
98.Pokedex: Krabby live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.

99.Name: Kingler
99.Pokedex: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this Pokémon quickly tires.

100.Name: Voltorb
100.Pokedex: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran trainers treat it with caution.

101.Name: Electrode
101.Pokedex: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.

102.Name: Exeggcute
102.Pokedex: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

103.Name: Exeggutor
103.Pokedex: Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.

104.Name: Cubone
104.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

105.Name: Marowak
105.Pokedex: Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

106.Name: Hitmonlee
106.Pokedex: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

107.Name: Hitmonchan
107.Pokedex: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an unbreakable spirit means that it will never give up.

108.Name: Lickitung
108.Pokedex: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

109.Name: Koffing
109.Pokedex: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell; they are also explosive!

110.Name: Weezing
110.Pokedex: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

111.Name: Rhyhorn
111.Pokedex: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

112.Name: Rhydon
112.Pokedex: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

113.Name: Chansey
113.Pokedex: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those who have lost their appetite.

114.Name: Tangela
114.Pokedex: The vines shrouding its body are always writhing, effectively unnerving foes. Lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

115.Name: Kangaskhan
115.Pokedex: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

116.Name: Horsea
116.Pokedex: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

117.Name: Seadra
117.Pokedex: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

118.Name: Goldeen
118.Pokedex: In the springtime, schools of Goldeen can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

119.Name: Seaking
119.Pokedex: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

120.Name: Staryu
120.Pokedex: Staryu appears to communicate telepathically with the stars in the night sky by flashing the red core at the center of its body.

121.Name: Starmie
121.Pokedex: Its colorful core--the gem of the sea--sends telepathic transmissions into outer space. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

122.Name: Mr. Mime
122.Pokedex: A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.

123.Name: Scyther
123.Pokedex: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

124.Name: Jynx
124.Pokedex: Its strange cries sound like human language. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

125.Name: Electabuzz
125.Pokedex: Electricity permeates its body. It swings its arms round and round to charge up electricity before unleashing a punch.

126.Name: Magmar
126.Pokedex: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

127.Name: Pinsir
127.Pokedex: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep underground.

128.Name: Tauros
128.Pokedex: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

129.Name: Magikarp
129.Pokedex: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. They live in waters all over the world!

130.Name: Gyarados
130.Pokedex: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

131.Name: Lapras
131.Pokedex: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

132.Name: Ditto
132.Pokedex: A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. If it tries to change based on its memory, however, it will get details wrong.

133.Name: Eevee
133.Pokedex: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.

134.Name: Vaporeon
134.Pokedex: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.

135.Name: Jolteon
135.Pokedex: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur's static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.

136.Name: Flareon
136.Pokedex: Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

137.Name: Porygon
137.Pokedex: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated.

138.Name: Omanyte
138.Pokedex: An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

139.Name: Omastar
139.Pokedex: An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.

140.Name: Kabuto
140.Pokedex: Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder. It also has eyes on its back that glow.

141.Name: Kabutops
141.Pokedex: Its sleek shape is adapted perfectly for both pursuit on land and in water. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

142.Name: Aerodactyl
142.Pokedex: In prehistoric times, this Pokémon flew freely and fearlessly through the skies. Its teeth are like saw blades.

143.Name: Snorlax
143.Pokedex: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.

144.Name: Articuno
144.Pokedex: Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.

145.Name: Zapdos
145.Pokedex: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon said to appear only when a thundercloud parts into two halves. It turns the sky turns dark as lightning showers down.

146.Name: Moltres
146.Pokedex: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

147.Name: Dratini
147.Pokedex: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

148.Name: Dragonair
148.Pokedex: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

149.Name: Dragonite
149.Pokedex: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

150.Name: Mewtwo
150.Pokedex: Created by scientists after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments, it's said to have the most ruthless heart among Pokémon.

151.Name: Mew
151.Pokedex: A Mew is said to possess the genes of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

152.Name: Chikorita
152.Pokedex: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

153.Name: Bayleef
153.Pokedex: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

154.Name: Meganium
154.Pokedex: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

155.Name: Cyndaquil
155.Pokedex: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

156.Name: Quilava
156.Pokedex: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

157.Name: Typhlosion
157.Pokedex: If you see a shimmering heat haze surrounding it, beware its impending rage. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

158.Name: Totodile
158.Pokedex: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

159.Name: Croconaw
159.Pokedex: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

160.Name: Feraligatr
160.Pokedex: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

161.Name: Sentret
161.Pokedex: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

162.Name: Ferrocket
162.Pokedex: Ferrocket's streamlined build allows it to deftly jet and maneuver through narrow spaces to escape pursuers while scorching them with its tail plume.

163.Name: Hoothoot
163.Pokedex: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

164.Name: Noctowl
164.Pokedex: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

165.Name: Ledyba
165.Pokedex: Ledyba communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

166.Name: Ledian
166.Pokedex: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

167.Name: Spinarak
167.Pokedex: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

168.Name: Ariados
168.Pokedex: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

169.Name: Crobat
169.Pokedex: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

170.Name: Chinchou
170.Pokedex: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

171.Name: Lanturn
171.Pokedex: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

172.Name: Pichu
172.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

173.Name: Cleffa
173.Pokedex: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

174.Name: Igglybuff
174.Pokedex: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

175.Name: Togepi
175.Pokedex: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

176.Name: Togetic
176.Pokedex: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

177.Name: Natu
177.Pokedex: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

178.Name: Xatu
178.Pokedex: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

179.Name: Mareep
179.Pokedex: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand you'll get a painful shock!

180.Name: Flaaffy
180.Pokedex: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

181.Name: Ampharos
181.Pokedex: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

182.Name: Bellossom
182.Pokedex: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a ritual dance for summoning the sun.

183.Name: Marill
183.Pokedex: Marill's oil-filled tail acts like a life preserver. If you see only its tail bobbing on the surface, Marill is feeding on aquatic plants below!

184.Name: Azumarill
184.Pokedex: It inflates itself to increase its power. It can also make air balloons to rescue drowning Pokémon and help them breathe.

185.Name: Sudowoodo
185.Pokedex: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

186.Name: Politoed
186.Pokedex: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

187.Name: Hoppip
187.Pokedex: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links with others to prepare against being blown away.

188.Name: Skiploom
188.Pokedex: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

189.Name: Jumpluff
189.Pokedex: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

190.Name: Aipom
190.Pokedex: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

191.Name: Sunkern
191.Pokedex: Sunkern try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

192.Name: Sunflora
192.Pokedex: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

193.Name: Yanma
193.Pokedex: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

194.Name: Wooper
194.Pokedex: Wooper usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

195.Name: Quagsire
195.Pokedex: A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

196.Name: Espeon
196.Pokedex: An Espeon is extremely loyal to any trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its trainer from harm.

197.Name: Umbreon
197.Pokedex: When exposed to moonlight or in times of great distress, the rings on its body glow faintly and fill it with a mysterious power to protect its trainer from harm.

198.Name: Murkrow
198.Pokedex: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

199.Name: Slowking
199.Pokedex: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the shell on its head comes off.

200.Name: Misdreavus
200.Pokedex: A Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.

201.Name: Unown
201.Pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

202.Name: Wobbuffet
202.Pokedex: Wobbuffet does nothing but endure attacks—it won't attack on its own. However, it won't endure an attack on its tail.

203.Name: Girafarig
203.Pokedex: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

204.Name: Pineco
204.Pokedex: A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

205.Name: Forretress
205.Pokedex: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

206.Name: Dunsparce
206.Pokedex: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

207.Name: Gligar
207.Pokedex: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.

208.Name: Steelix
208.Pokedex: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. Tempered under high pressure and heat, their bodies are harder than any metal.

209.Name: Snubbull
209.Pokedex: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying in terror. The Snubbull does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.

210.Name: Granbull
210.Pokedex: It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by revealing its big fangs... But Granbulls are actually timid and easily spooked!

211.Name: Qwilfish
211.Pokedex: Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. It can shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

212.Name: Scizor
212.Pokedex: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

213.Name: Shuckle
213.Pokedex: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

214.Name: Heracross
214.Pokedex: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them. It loves sweet honey.

215.Name: Sneasel
215.Pokedex: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

216.Name: Teddiursa
216.Pokedex: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

217.Name: Ursaring
217.Pokedex: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an Ursaring gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

218.Name: Slugma
218.Pokedex: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

219.Name: Magcargo
219.Pokedex: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned Magcargo's bodies into magma.

220.Name: Swinub
220.Pokedex: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

221.Name: Piloswine
221.Pokedex: A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

222.Name: Corsola
222.Pokedex: CORSOLA's branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this POKéMON grows it back in just one night.

223.Name: Remoraid
223.Pokedex: A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. It has superb accuracy.

224.Name: Octillery
224.Pokedex: This highly intelligent Pokemon makes its home in small crevices or openings and can precisely shoot down prey from over 200 meters.

225.Name: Delibird
225.Pokedex: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who scaled the tallest mountain in the world thanks to a Delibird's help.

226.Name: Mantine
226.Pokedex: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

227.Name: Skarmory
227.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from Skarmory to make swords and knives.

228.Name: Houndour
228.Pokedex: Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack to corner prey. Around dawn, their ominous howls echo through their territory.

229.Name: Houndoom
229.Pokedex: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it. Today, people still fear its painful burns.

230.Name: Kingdra
230.Pokedex: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

231.Name: Phanpy
231.Pokedex: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

232.Name: Donphan
232.Pokedex: A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

233.Name: Porygon2
233.Pokedex: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

234.Name: Stantler
234.Pokedex: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

235.Name: Smeargle
235.Pokedex: A Smeargle marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

236.Name: Tyrogue
236.Pokedex: Tyrogue become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the trainer must establish a regular training schedule.

237.Name: Hitmontop
237.Pokedex: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. Hitmontop travel faster spinning than they do walking.

238.Name: Smoochum
238.Pokedex: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

239.Name: Elekid
239.Pokedex: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

240.Name: Magby
240.Pokedex: If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

241.Name: Miltank
241.Pokedex: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

242.Name: Blissey
242.Pokedex: This kindhearted Pokémon delivers happiness and nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

243.Name: Raikou
243.Pokedex: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.

244.Name: Entei
244.Pokedex: Entei embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. Its molten fire consumes all that it touches.

245.Name: Suicune
245.Pokedex: Suicune embodies the elegance of a pure spring of water. It dashes away with the north wind. It has the power to purify dirty water.

246.Name: Larvitar
246.Pokedex: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

247.Name: Pupitar
247.Pokedex: This dangerous pupa thrashes about. Its shell is as hard as bedrock, containing its gradually forming new body within.

248.Name: Tyranitar
248.Pokedex: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

249.Name: Lugia
249.Pokedex: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

250.Name: Ho-Oh
250.Pokedex: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

251.Name: Celebi
251.Pokedex: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

252.Name: Treecko
252.Pokedex: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory.

253.Name: Grovyle
253.Pokedex: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

254.Name: Sceptile
254.Pokedex: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

255.Name: Torchic
255.Pokedex: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

256.Name: Combusken
256.Pokedex: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

257.Name: Blaziken
257.Pokedex: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon's wrists burn.

258.Name: Mudkip
258.Pokedex: The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving.

259.Name: Marshtomp
259.Pokedex: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing, quickly overwhelming foes struggling in mud.

260.Name: Swampert
260.Pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects itself by piling up boulders. It can swim while towing a large ship.

261.Name: Poochyena
261.Pokedex: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

262.Name: Mightyena
262.Pokedex: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

263.Name: Tadbulb
263.Pokedex: Tadbulbs only blink their heads on to attract prey. As such, primitive societies would feed them in order to light their houses.

264.Name: Judohm
264.Pokedex: Its internal dynamo burns through energy quickly when it wrestles prey. But if well-fed, it produces electricity very consistently.

265.Name: Wurmple
265.Pokedex: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

266.Name: Silcoon
266.Pokedex: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

267.Name: Beautifly
267.Pokedex: Despite its beautiful appearance, it is savage. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

268.Name: Cascoon
268.Pokedex: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

269.Name: Dustox
269.Pokedex: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

270.Name: Lotad
270.Pokedex: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

271.Name: Lombre
271.Pokedex: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

272.Name: Ludicolo
272.Pokedex: When it hears bright, festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated and download the rhythm, making it more powerful.

273.Name: Seedot
273.Pokedex: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

274.Name: Nuzleaf
274.Pokedex: A highly intelligent trickster Pokémon that dwells deep in forests. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

275.Name: Shiftry
275.Pokedex: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people dare not venture.

276.Name: Taillow
276.Pokedex: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

277.Name: Swellow
277.Pokedex: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

278.Name: Wingull
278.Pokedex: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

279.Name: Pelipper
279.Pokedex: It skims its large bill in the sea to scoop up food and water. It also uses its bill to carry small Pokémon and eggs to safety.

280.Name: Ralts
280.Pokedex: Ralts has the ability to sense the emotions of people. If its trainer is in a cheerful mood, this Pokémon grows cheerful and joyous in the same way.

281.Name: Kirlia
281.Pokedex: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

282.Name: Gardevoir
282.Pokedex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its trainer.

283.Name: Surskit
283.Pokedex: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

284.Name: Masquerain
284.Pokedex: Its antennae have intimidating eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

285.Name: Shroomish
285.Pokedex: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

286.Name: Breloom
286.Pokedex: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

287.Name: Slakoth
287.Pokedex: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

288.Name: Vigoroth
288.Pokedex: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

289.Name: Slaking
289.Pokedex: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

290.Name: Nincada
290.Pokedex: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

291.Name: Ninjask
291.Pokedex: Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

292.Name: Shedinja
292.Pokedex: its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into it from its back.

293.Name: Whismur
293.Pokedex: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

294.Name: Loudred
294.Pokedex: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

295.Name: Exploud
295.Pokedex: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

296.Name: Makuhita
296.Pokedex: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

297.Name: Hariyama
297.Pokedex: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

298.Name: Azurill
298.Pokedex: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

299.Name: Nosepass
299.Pokedex: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

300.Name: Skitty
300.Pokedex: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

301.Name: Delcatty
301.Pokedex: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It dislikes dirty places.

302.Name: Sableye
302.Pokedex: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

303.Name: Mawile
303.Pokedex: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

304.Name: Aron
304.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

305.Name: Lairon
305.Pokedex: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

306.Name: Aggron
306.Pokedex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

307.Name: Meditite
307.Pokedex: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

308.Name: Medicham
308.Pokedex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance-like movement.

309.Name: Coiliger
309.Pokedex: It generates plasma in its coil tail using air pressure. With sufficient energy, it can enter a plasma state and warp through the ground.

310.Name: Tesliger
310.Pokedex: The tower on its back can convert the rest of its body into plasma, absorb it into the sphere on top, then warp through the ground.

311.Name: Plusle
311.Pokedex: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

312.Name: Minun
312.Pokedex: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

313.Name: Volbeat
313.Pokedex: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

314.Name: Illumise
314.Pokedex: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

315.Name: Roselia
315.Pokedex: The beautiful flowers on its arms have toxic thorns. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.

316.Name: Gulpin
316.Pokedex: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

317.Name: Swalot
317.Pokedex: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

318.Name: Carvanha
318.Pokedex: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

319.Name: Sharpedo
319.Pokedex: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

320.Name: Wailmer
320.Pokedex: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

321.Name: Wailord
321.Pokedex: Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

322.Name: Numel
322.Pokedex: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

323.Name: Camerupt
323.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

324.Name: Torkoal
324.Pokedex: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

325.Name: Spoink
325.Pokedex: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

326.Name: Grumpig
326.Pokedex: The pearls on its forehead release psychic power that cause Grumpig to perform odd movements--which became a hugely popular style of dancing overseas!

327.Name: Spinda
327.Pokedex: No two Spinda are said to have identical spot patterns. This Pokémon moves in a curious manner; its lurching movements lead many to think it is possessed.

328.Name: Trapinch
328.Pokedex: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

329.Name: Vibrava
329.Pokedex: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

330.Name: Flygon
330.Pokedex: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

331.Name: Cacnea
331.Pokedex: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

332.Name: Cacturne
332.Pokedex: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

333.Name: Swablu
333.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

334.Name: Altaria
334.Pokedex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

335.Name: Zangoose
335.Pokedex: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

336.Name: Seviper
336.Pokedex: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

337.Name: Lunatone
337.Pokedex: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 400 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

338.Name: Solrock
338.Pokedex: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

339.Name: Barboach
339.Pokedex: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

340.Name: Whiscash
340.Pokedex: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

341.Name: Corphish
341.Pokedex: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

342.Name: Crawdaunt
342.Pokedex: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

343.Name: Baltoy
343.Pokedex: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

344.Name: Claydol
344.Pokedex: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

345.Name: Lileep
345.Pokedex: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole.

346.Name: Cradily
346.Pokedex: This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.

347.Name: Anorith
347.Pokedex: This Pokémon swam in the primordial sea by undulating its eight wings. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

348.Name: Armaldo
348.Pokedex: Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates. Though it lives on land, it's also a good swimmer.

349.Name: Feebas
349.Pokedex: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

350.Name: Milotic
350.Pokedex: Milotic's glittering rainbow scales have provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

351.Name: Castform
351.Pokedex: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

352.Name: Kecleon
352.Pokedex: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

353.Name: Shuppet
353.Pokedex: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

354.Name: Banette
354.Pokedex: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

355.Name: Duskull
355.Pokedex: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

356.Name: Dusclops
356.Pokedex: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

357.Name: Tropius
357.Pokedex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

358.Name: Chimecho
358.Pokedex: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

359.Name: Absol
359.Pokedex: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

360.Name: Wynaut
360.Pokedex: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.

361.Name: Snorunt
361.Pokedex: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

362.Name: Glalie
362.Pokedex: Glalie has a body made of minerals hardened with an armor of solid ice. This POKéMON hunts by instantly freezing moisture in the atmosphere.

363.Name: Spheal
363.Pokedex: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.

364.Name: Sealeo
364.Pokedex: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

365.Name: Walrein
365.Pokedex: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

366.Name: Clamperl
366.Pokedex: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

367.Name: Huntail
367.Pokedex: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

368.Name: Gorebyss
368.Pokedex: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

369.Name: Relicanth
369.Pokedex: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form since the beginning of time. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

370.Name: Luvdisc
370.Pokedex: Luvdisc are aggregates of sea-garbage that have developed sentience. They shape themselves into hearts desperately hoping someone will love them.

371.Name: Bagon
371.Pokedex: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches into things with its ironlike skull.

372.Name: Shelgon
372.Pokedex: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

373.Name: Salamence
373.Pokedex: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

374.Name: Beldum
374.Pokedex: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

375.Name: Metang
375.Pokedex: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

376.Name: Metagross
376.Pokedex: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

377.Name: Regirock
377.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.

378.Name: Regice
378.Pokedex: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

379.Name: Registeel
379.Pokedex: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

380.Name: Latias
380.Pokedex: It is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. Latias refracts light with its down to alter its appearance.

381.Name: Latios
381.Pokedex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

382.Name: Kyogre
382.Pokedex: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

383.Name: Groudon
383.Pokedex: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

384.Name: Rayquaza
384.Pokedex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

385.Name: Jirachi
385.Pokedex: When it awakens, Jirachi will make any wish written on the note on its head come true. It can sense danger and fights or flees without awakening.

386.Name: Deoxys
386.Pokedex: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

387.Name: Turtwig
387.Pokedex: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

388.Name: Grotle
388.Pokedex: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

389.Name: Torterra
389.Pokedex: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

390.Name: Chimchar
390.Pokedex: Full of vigor and always in high spirits, it adroitly scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains.

391.Name: Monferno
391.Pokedex: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance. It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks.

392.Name: Infernape
392.Pokedex: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its quick and fiery movements look like a magnificent dance!

393.Name: Piplup
393.Pokedex: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

394.Name: Prinplup
394.Pokedex: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

395.Name: Empoleon
395.Pokedex: It has a well-tempered demeanor despite its commandingly haughty poise. But if its pride is truly threatened, beware its power.

396.Name: Starly
396.Pokedex: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

397.Name: Staravia
397.Pokedex: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves for mates and prowess.

398.Name: Staraptor
398.Pokedex: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger, yet still fusses over the shape of its comb.

399.Name: Bidoof
399.Pokedex: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

400.Name: Bibarel
400.Pokedex: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

401.Name: Kricketot
401.Pokedex: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

402.Name: Kricketune
402.Pokedex: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

403.Name: Shinx
403.Pokedex: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

404.Name: Luxio
404.Pokedex: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

405.Name: Luxray
405.Pokedex: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

406.Name: Budew
406.Pokedex: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun's warm touch.

407.Name: Roserade
407.Pokedex: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

408.Name: Cranidos
408.Pokedex: It lived in jungles around 10 thousand years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

409.Name: Rampardos
409.Pokedex: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. It is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.

410.Name: Shieldon
410.Pokedex: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, or so it's thought.

411.Name: Bastiodon
411.Pokedex: When attacked, they form a wall. Their terrifyingly tough faces serve to protect them from any frontal attacks.

412.Name: H. Zorua
412.Pokedex: A once-departed soul, it derives power from resentment. Zorua stalk cold and uninhabited regions, venting lingering malice.

413.Name: H. Zoroark
413.Pokedex: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. It is an intensely hateful and bitter Pokemon.

414.Name: Zarude
414.Pokedex: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

415.Name: Combee
415.Pokedex: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.

416.Name: Vespiquen
416.Pokedex: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

417.Name: Pachirisu
417.Pokedex: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

418.Name: Buizel
418.Pokedex: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

419.Name: Floatzel
419.Pokedex: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

420.Name: Cherubi
420.Pokedex: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

421.Name: Cherrim
421.Pokedex: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

422.Name: Divalve
422.Pokedex: The head grows the rest of its oozing body by diving through the earth and draining it of mineral-rich groundwater. It prefers humid climates.

423.Name: Helmussel
423.Pokedex: A mineral-rich cord runs the length of its body. Though it travels through the ground, modern submaries were designed based on its body composition.

424.Name: Ambipom
424.Pokedex: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

425.Name: Drifloon
425.Pokedex: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

426.Name: Drifblim
426.Pokedex: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

427.Name: Buneary
427.Pokedex: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

428.Name: Lopunny
428.Pokedex: It's notably wary. Despite its dislike of battling, it's a natural fighter that can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.

429.Name: Mismagius
429.Pokedex: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

430.Name: Honchkrow
430.Pokedex: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.

431.Name: Oscillot
431.Pokedex: If it sidles up next to you, you can't tell if it will cuddle you or wrap around and electrocute you. Somehow its fickleness is popular.

432.Name: Jagwire
432.Pokedex: An intimidating enforcer, it binds its body with its cable tails to empower itself. Its foliage wilts if it doesn't do enough bullying.

433.Name: Chingling
433.Pokedex: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

434.Name: Stunky
434.Pokedex: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

435.Name: Skuntank
435.Pokedex: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

436.Name: Bronzor
436.Pokedex: The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

437.Name: Bronzong
437.Pokedex: Bronzong was thought to call rain from portals to other worlds. Regardless, it is still revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

438.Name: Bonsly
438.Pokedex: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

439.Name: Mime Jr.
439.Pokedex: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.

440.Name: Happiny
440.Pokedex: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped object in imitation of Chansey.

441.Name: Chatot
441.Pokedex: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

442.Name: Spiritomb
442.Pokedex: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

443.Name: Gible
443.Pokedex: Gible attacks anything that moves using its huge mouth. It drags whatever it catches into the geothermal crevices that serve as its lairs.

444.Name: Gabite
444.Pokedex: It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used for medicine.

445.Name: Garchomp
445.Pokedex: Exceedingly savage, It preys on the weak and confronts the strong. It uses every rough or sharp edge on its body as a weapon.

446.Name: Munchlax
446.Pokedex: It seems to wolf down half of its weight in food every day, sometimes swallowing things whole without even chewing.

447.Name: Riolu
447.Pokedex: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

448.Name: Lucario
448.Pokedex: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

449.Name: Hippopotas
449.Pokedex: Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

450.Name: Hippowdon
450.Pokedex: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

451.Name: Skorupi
451.Pokedex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

452.Name: Drapion
452.Pokedex: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

453.Name: Croagunk
453.Pokedex: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival.

454.Name: Toxicroak
454.Pokedex: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

455.Name: Carnivine
455.Pokedex: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

456.Name: Finneon
456.Pokedex: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

457.Name: Lumineon
457.Pokedex: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

458.Name: Mantyke
458.Pokedex: Mantyke is a friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

459.Name: Snover
459.Pokedex: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

460.Name: Abomasnow
460.Pokedex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

461.Name: Weavile
461.Pokedex: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

462.Name: Magnezone
462.Pokedex: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

463.Name: Stickilicky
463.Pokedex: It snatches up things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with strings of sticky, corrosive drool.

464.Name: Rhyperior
464.Pokedex: It puts rubble in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

465.Name: Tangrowth
465.Pokedex: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

466.Name: Electivire
466.Pokedex: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in and pushes the tips of its tails against its foes. It then excitedly looses a high-voltage current.

467.Name: Magmortar
467.Pokedex: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

468.Name: Togekiss
468.Pokedex: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

469.Name: Yanmega
469.Pokedex: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

470.Name: Leafeon
470.Pokedex: This Pokémon's tail is blade sharp, with a fantastic cutting edge that can slice right though large trees.

471.Name: Glaceon
471.Pokedex: It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that's around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.

472.Name: Gliscor
472.Pokedex: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

473.Name: Mamoswine
473.Pokedex: As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks grow longer, thicker, and more impressive. Its population was more robust before the ice age.

474.Name: Porigen-Z
474.Pokedex: Additional software was installed to make it into an unbeatable Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

475.Name: Gallade
475.Pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

476.Name: Probopass
476.Pokedex: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

477.Name: Dusknoir
