477.Pokedex: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

478.Name: Froslass
478.Pokedex: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

479.Name: Rotom
479.Pokedex: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to possess electronic devices and wreak havoc.

480.Name: Uxie
480.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

481.Name: Mesprit
481.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

482.Name: Azelf
482.Pokedex: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life's difficulties.

483.Name: Dialga
483.Pokedex: It has the power to distort time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

484.Name: Palkia
484.Pokedex: It has the power to distort space. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

485.Name: Heatran
485.Pokedex: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It is partially melted in spots because of its own heat, however.

486.Name: Regigigas
486.Pokedex: It's said that Regigigas created other Pokémon from many different materials before it moved the continents to where they are today.

487.Name: Giratina
487.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

488.Name: Cresselia
488.Pokedex: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

489.Name: Phione
489.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

490.Name: Manaphy
490.Pokedex: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

491.Name: Darkrai
491.Pokedex: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares.

492.Name: Shaymin
492.Pokedex: It can dissolve toxins in the air to transform ruined land into lush fields. The flowers on its body bloom if it senses gratitude.

493.Name: Arceus
493.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

494.Name: Victini
494.Pokedex: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

495.Name: Snivy
495.Pokedex: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

496.Name: Servine
496.Pokedex: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

497.Name: Serperior
497.Pokedex: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior's noble eyes.

498.Name: Tepig
498.Pokedex: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

499.Name: Pignite
499.Pokedex: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

500.Name: Emboar
500.Pokedex: A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is indeed all fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.

501.Name: Oshawott
501.Pokedex: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

502.Name: Dewott
502.Pokedex: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

503.Name: Samurott
503.Pokedex: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

504.Name: Patrat
504.Pokedex: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

505.Name: Watchog
505.Pokedex: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

506.Name: Lillipup
506.Pokedex: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

507.Name: Herdier
507.Pokedex: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

508.Name: Stoutland
508.Pokedex: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it's a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

509.Name: Purrloin
509.Pokedex: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

510.Name: Liepard
510.Pokedex: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

511.Name: Pansage
511.Pokedex: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to induce stress.

512.Name: Simisage
512.Pokedex: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

513.Name: Pansear
513.Pokedex: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

514.Name: Simisear
514.Pokedex: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

515.Name: Panpour
515.Pokedex: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

516.Name: Simipour
516.Pokedex: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful it can destroy a concrete wall.

517.Name: Munna
517.Pokedex: Always floating in the air, Munna eat the dreams of people and Pokémon. They expel different gases depending on the types of dreams they eat.

518.Name: Musharna
518.Pokedex: Munna fall into a permanent trance when they evolve. Musharna can manipulate gases, often shaping them into things from dreams it has eaten.

519.Name: Pidove
519.Pokedex: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

520.Name: Tranquill
520.Pokedex: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

521.Name: Unfezant
521.Pokedex: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

522.Name: Blitzle
522.Pokedex: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

523.Name: Zebstrika
523.Pokedex: These ill-tempered Pokémon have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

524.Name: Roggenrola
524.Pokedex: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

525.Name: Boldore
525.Pokedex: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

526.Name: Gigalith
526.Pokedex: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

527.Name: Woobat
527.Pokedex: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

528.Name: Swoobat
528.Pokedex: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

529.Name: Drilbur
529.Pokedex: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

530.Name: Excadrill
530.Pokedex: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph more than 300 feet below the surface.

531.Name: Audino
531.Pokedex: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

532.Name: Timburr
532.Pokedex: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

533.Name: Gurdurr
533.Pokedex: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

534.Name: Conkeldurr
534.Pokedex: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

535.Name: Tympole
535.Pokedex: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

536.Name: Palpitoad
536.Pokedex: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

537.Name: Seismitoad
537.Pokedex: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

538.Name: Throh
538.Pokedex: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

539.Name: Sawk
539.Pokedex: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

540.Name: Sewaddle
540.Pokedex: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

541.Name: Swadloon
541.Pokedex: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

542.Name: Leavanny
542.Pokedex: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

543.Name: Venipede
543.Pokedex: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.

544.Name: Whirlipede
544.Pokedex: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

545.Name: Scolipede
545.Pokedex: Highly aggressive, it chases down its foes with quick movements. It attacks relentlessly with its horns and toxic neck spikes until it prevails.

546.Name: Cottonee
546.Pokedex: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

547.Name: Whimsicott
547.Pokedex: They appear riding whirlwinds. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

548.Name: Petilil
548.Pokedex: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape!

549.Name: Lilligant
549.Pokedex: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.

550.Name: Basculin
550.Pokedex: Savage, violent Pokémon, Basculin are always fighting each other over territory. Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook.

551.Name: Sandile
551.Pokedex: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

552.Name: Krokorok
552.Pokedex: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings, even in darkness.

553.Name: Krookodile
553.Pokedex: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

554.Name: Darumaka
554.Pokedex: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

555.Name: Darmanitan
555.Pokedex: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

556.Name: Maractus
556.Pokedex: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

557.Name: Dwebble
557.Pokedex: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

558.Name: Crustle
558.Pokedex: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

559.Name: Scraggy
559.Pokedex: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

560.Name: Scrafty
560.Pokedex: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

561.Name: Sigilyph
561.Pokedex: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

562.Name: Yamask
562.Pokedex: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

563.Name: Cofagrigus
563.Pokedex: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are seemingly covered in pure gold.

564.Name: Tirtouga
564.Pokedex: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to and survive at ocean depths of over half a mile.

565.Name: Carracosta
565.Pokedex: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A wave generated by one of them is enough to capsize a tanker.

566.Name: Archen
566.Pokedex: These Pokemon glided down from treetops to snag prey, but were notorious for giving up easily. Perhaps this is why they went extinct...

567.Name: Archeops
567.Pokedex: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey, but give up easily. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

568.Name: Trubbish
568.Pokedex: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

569.Name: Garbodor
569.Pokedex: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

570.Name: Zorua
570.Pokedex: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

571.Name: Zoroark
571.Pokedex: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

572.Name: Minccino
572.Pokedex: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

573.Name: Cinccino
573.Pokedex: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. They are playful and caring, but can adroitly wield their scarves and icy tendrils!

574.Name: Gothita
574.Pokedex: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

575.Name: Gothorita
575.Pokedex: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

576.Name: Gothitelle
576.Pokedex: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again. They can see life spans.

577.Name: Solosis
577.Pokedex: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

578.Name: Duosion
578.Pokedex: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

579.Name: Reuniclus
579.Pokedex: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

580.Name: Ducklett
580.Pokedex: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

581.Name: Swanna
581.Pokedex: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

582.Name: Vanillite
582.Pokedex: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

583.Name: Vanillish
583.Pokedex: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

584.Name: Vanilluxe
584.Pokedex: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

585.Name: Deerling
585.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

586.Name: Sawsbuck
586.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

587.Name: Emolga
587.Pokedex: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane. They have to be careful not to get struck by lightning!

588.Name: Karrablast
588.Pokedex: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

589.Name: Escavalier
589.Pokedex: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

590.Name: Foongus
590.Pokedex: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

591.Name: Amoonguss
591.Pokedex: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

592.Name: Frillish
592.Pokedex: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

593.Name: Jellicent
593.Pokedex: Their favorite food is life energy. The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitat: all sunken, all vanished, all lost.

594.Name: Alomomola
594.Pokedex: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

595.Name: Joltik
595.Pokedex: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. They soak up electricity because they can't produce a charge on their own.

596.Name: Galvantula
596.Pokedex: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

597.Name: Ferroseed
597.Pokedex: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

598.Name: Ferrothorn
598.Pokedex: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

599.Name: Klink
599.Pokedex: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

600.Name: Klang
600.Pokedex: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

601.Name: Klinklang
601.Pokedex: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

602.Name: Tynamo
602.Pokedex: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

603.Name: Eelektrik
603.Pokedex: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

604.Name: Eelektross
604.Pokedex: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

605.Name: Elgyem
605.Pokedex: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.

606.Name: Beheeyem
606.Pokedex: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

607.Name: Litwick
607.Pokedex: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

608.Name: Lampent
608.Pokedex: It arrives near the moment of death and steals the spirit from the body.

609.Name: Chandelure
609.Pokedex: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

610.Name: Axew
610.Pokedex: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

611.Name: Fraxure
611.Pokedex: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

612.Name: Haxorus
612.Pokedex: Haxorus attack other powerful Pokemon for sport or territory. Their axe-blade tusks are their pride and joy... and are incredibly destructive.

613.Name: Cubchoo
613.Pokedex: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

614.Name: Beartic
614.Pokedex: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. It swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

615.Name: Cryogonal
615.Pokedex: They are composed of chains of ice crystals. They capture prey with these chains of ice, absorbing them into itself.

616.Name: Shelmet
616.Pokedex: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

617.Name: Accelgor
617.Pokedex: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

618.Name: Stunfisk
618.Pokedex: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of energy.

619.Name: Mienfoo
619.Pokedex: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

620.Name: Mienshao
620.Pokedex: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

621.Name: Druddigon
621.Pokedex: Despite dwelling in caves, it warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

622.Name: Golett
622.Pokedex: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

623.Name: Golurk
623.Pokedex: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

624.Name: Pawniard
624.Pokedex: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

625.Name: Bisharp
625.Pokedex: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

626.Name: Bouffalant
626.Pokedex: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. They headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

627.Name: Rufflet
627.Pokedex: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

628.Name: Braviary
628.Pokedex: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky receive from their peers.

629.Name: Vullaby
629.Pokedex: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They only attack the weakest Pokémon.

630.Name: Mandibuzz
630.Pokedex: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

631.Name: Heatmor
631.Pokedex: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

632.Name: Durant
632.Pokedex: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.

633.Name: Deino
633.Pokedex: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

634.Name: Zweilous
634.Pokedex: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

635.Name: Hydreigon
635.Pokedex: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

636.Name: Larvesta
636.Pokedex: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

637.Name: Volcarona
637.Pokedex: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

638.Name: Cobalion
638.Pokedex: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

639.Name: Terrakion
639.Pokedex: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

640.Name: Virizion
640.Pokedex: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

641.Name: Tornadus
641.Pokedex: Tornadus expels massive squalls from its tail as it flies about. Its power is great enough to sweep entire towns away.

642.Name: Thundurus
642.Pokedex: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies across regions discharging bolts at whim.

643.Name: Reshiram
643.Pokedex: According to myth, if people ignore truth and become corrupt, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

644.Name: Zekrom
644.Pokedex: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom's lightning.

645.Name: Landorus
645.Pokedex: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

646.Name: Kyurem
646.Pokedex: This legendary Pokémon of ultracold air waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

647.Name: Keldeo
647.Pokedex: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon's true power will awaken.

648.Name: Meloetta
648.Pokedex: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

649.Name: Genesect
649.Pokedex: This bug Pokémon was mutated by genetic experimentation and augmented with powerful technology. It is considered the ultimate weapon.

650.Name: Chespin
650.Pokedex: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

651.Name: Quilladin
651.Pokedex: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

652.Name: Chesnaught
652.Pokedex: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

653.Name: Fennekin
653.Pokedex: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

654.Name: Braixen
654.Pokedex: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

655.Name: Delphox
655.Pokedex: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

656.Name: Froakie
656.Pokedex: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

657.Name: Frogadier
657.Pokedex: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

658.Name: Greninja
658.Pokedex: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

659.Name: Bunnelby
659.Pokedex: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

660.Name: Diggersby
660.Pokedex: More powerful than an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.

661.Name: Fletchling
661.Pokedex: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

662.Name: Fletchinder
662.Pokedex: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

663.Name: Talonflame
663.Pokedex: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

664.Name: Scatterbug
664.Pokedex: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

665.Name: Spewpa
665.Pokedex: The beaks of bird Pokémon are often irratated by its bristly body. It spews powder to defend itself.

666.Name: Vivillon
666.Pokedex: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

667.Name: Litleo
667.Pokedex: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

668.Name: Pyroar
668.Pokedex: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride’s cubs.

669.Name: Flabebe
669.Pokedex: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.

670.Name: Floette
670.Pokedex: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the power of flowers to battle.

671.Name: Florges
671.Pokedex: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

672.Name: Skiddo
672.Pokedex: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to be domesticated by humans, it has an energized, playful disposition.

673.Name: Gogoat
673.Pokedex: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a thunderous battle of clashing horns.

674.Name: Pancham
674.Pokedex: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

675.Name: Pangoro
675.Pokedex: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

676.Name: Furfrou
676.Pokedex: Historically, these Pokemon were the designated guardians of the king of the Telius region.

677.Name: Espurr
677.Pokedex: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself, but it has no control over its power.

678.Name: Meowstic
678.Pokedex: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

679.Name: Honedge
679.Pokedex: Apparently this Pokemon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

680.Name: Doublade
680.Pokedex: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

681.Name: Aegislash
681.Pokedex: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

682.Name: Spritzee
682.Pokedex: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

683.Name: Aromatisse
683.Pokedex: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

684.Name: Swirlix
684.Pokedex: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

685.Name: Slurpuff
685.Pokedex: Its sense of smell is a million times better than a human's, so even the faintest scent tells it about everything in the area. It's like it can see with its nose!

686.Name: Inkay
686.Pokedex: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

687.Name: Malamar
687.Pokedex: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

688.Name: Binacle
688.Pokedex: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

689.Name: Barbaracle
689.Pokedex: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

690.Name: Skrelp
690.Pokedex: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on any prey that approaches unawares.

691.Name: Dragalge
691.Pokedex: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge dwell, never to return.

692.Name: Clauncher
692.Pokedex: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

693.Name: Clawitzer
693.Pokedex: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

694.Name: Helioptile
694.Pokedex: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

695.Name: Heliolisk
695.Pokedex: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

696.Name: Tyrunt
696.Pokedex: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

697.Name: Tyrantrum
697.Pokedex: The king of the ancient world, it can easily crunch a car with the devastating strength of its enormous jaws.

698.Name: Amaura
698.Pokedex: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It's said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.

699.Name: Aurorus
699.Pokedex: Its diamond-shaped crystals expel freezing air. It's said that when this Pokémon cries, auroras appear in the night sky.

700.Name: Sylveon
700.Pokedex: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, its soothing aura calming fights.

701.Name: Hawlucha
701.Pokedex: It drives opponents to exhaustion with agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with its signature pose and awesome over-the-top-rope maneuver!

702.Name: Dedenne
702.Pokedex: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

703.Name: Carbink
703.Pokedex: It has slept underground for thousands of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

704.Name: Goomy
704.Pokedex: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly. It lives in damp, shady places.

705.Name: Sliggoo
705.Pokedex: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see well.

706.Name: Goodra
706.Pokedex: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokemon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

707.Name: Klefki
707.Pokedex: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

708.Name: Phantump
708.Pokedex: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

709.Name: Trevenant
709.Pokedex: It can control trees at will. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

710.Name: Pumpkaboo
710.Pokedex: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

711.Name: Gourgeist
711.Pokedex: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

712.Name: Bergmite
712.Pokedex: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

713.Name: Avalugg
713.Pokedex: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

714.Name: Noibat
714.Pokedex: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

715.Name: Noivern
715.Pokedex: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

716.Name: Xerneas
716.Pokedex: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

717.Name: Yveltal
717.Pokedex: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

718.Name: Zygarde-50%
718.Pokedex: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

719.Name: Diancie
719.Pokedex: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

720.Name: Hoopa
720.Pokedex: It gathers things it likes and pushes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

721.Name: Volcanion
721.Pokedex: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

722.Name: Rowlet
722.Pokedex: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. Rowlets are also known to endearingly use Trainers' pockets or bags as nests.

723.Name: Dartrix
723.Pokedex: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

724.Name: Decidueye
724.Pokedex: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision that they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

725.Name: Litten
725.Pokedex: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

726.Name: Torracat
726.Pokedex: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

727.Name: Incineroar
727.Pokedex: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. It uses any tactics available to win and excels at brutal, no-holds-barred battles.

728.Name: Popplio
728.Pokedex: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It is famous for being a hard worker.

729.Name: Brionne
729.Pokedex: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

730.Name: Primarina
730.Pokedex: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

731.Name: Pikipek
731.Pokedex: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

732.Name: Trumbeak
732.Pokedex: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

733.Name: Toucannon
733.Pokedex: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

734.Name: Yungoos
734.Pokedex: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.

735.Name: Gumshoos
735.Pokedex: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location, but it is always snoozing by nightfall.

736.Name: Grubbin
736.Pokedex: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

737.Name: Charjabug
737.Pokedex: Its body is capable of storing electricity. People are grateful to have one around on camping trips!

738.Name: Vikavolt
738.Pokedex: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

739.Name: Crabrawler
739.Pokedex: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

740.Name: Crabominable
740.Pokedex: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

741.Name: Oricorio
741.Pokedex: It captivates its opponents with its dazzling dance moves. When they let their guard down, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

742.Name: Cutiefly
742.Pokedex: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

743.Name: Ribombee
743.Pokedex: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

744.Name: Rockruff
744.Pokedex: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

745.Name: Lycanroc
745.Pokedex: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.

746.Name: Wishiwashi
746.Pokedex: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

747.Name: Mareanie
747.Pokedex: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

748.Name: Toxapex
748.Pokedex: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

749.Name: Mudbray
749.Pokedex: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.

750.Name: Mudsdale
750.Pokedex: Its strength, stamina, and stubbornness are unprecedented. It easily hauls 10 ton loads and splinters concrete foundations.

751.Name: Dewpider
751.Pokedex: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

752.Name: Araquanid
752.Pokedex: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds weak, vulnerable Pokémon, it protects them and brings them into its water bubble.

753.Name: Fomantis
753.Pokedex: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

754.Name: Lurantis
754.Pokedex: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis' vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

755.Name: Morelull
755.Pokedex: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

756.Name: Shiinotic
756.Pokedex: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

757.Name: Salandit
757.Pokedex: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

758.Name: Salazzle
758.Pokedex: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted for use in the production of luscious perfumes.

759.Name: Stufful
759.Pokedex: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

760.Name: Bewear
760.Pokedex: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

761.Name: Bounsweet
761.Pokedex: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

762.Name: Steenee
762.Pokedex: This Pokémon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokémon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.

763.Name: Tsareena
763.Pokedex: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show, but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

764.Name: Comfey
764.Pokedex: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

765.Name: Oranguru
765.Pokedex: This Pokémon abides deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

766.Name: Passimian
766.Pokedex: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. They battle with hard berries for weapons.

767.Name: Wimpod
767.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

768.Name: Golisopod
768.Pokedex: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater, or even air, right in two.

769.Name: Sandygast
769.Pokedex: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.

770.Name: Palossand
770.Pokedex: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

771.Name: Pyukumuku
771.Pokedex: These Pokémon line the beaches. The sticky mucus that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

772.Name: Type: Null
772.Pokedex: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.

773.Name: Type: Full
773.Pokedex: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

774.Name: Minior
774.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born from mutated nanoparticles and cannot remain exposed for long. Its shell is part of its core body but takes on different properties.

775.Name: Komala
775.Pokedex: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

776.Name: Turtonator
776.Pokedex: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

777.Name: Togedemaru
777.Pokedex: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

778.Name: Mimikyu
778.Pokedex: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

779.Name: G-Stunfisk
779.Pokedex: It uses conspicuous powers to lure prey in as it lies in wait. Stunfisk keeps its jagged steel fins clamped down using telepathy.

780.Name: Drampa
780.Pokedex: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

781.Name: Dhelmise
781.Pokedex: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually part of its body.

782.Name: Jangmo-o
782.Pokedex: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

783.Name: Hakamo-o
783.Pokedex: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

784.Name: Kommo-o
784.Pokedex: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

785.Name: Tapu Koko
785.Pokedex: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

786.Name: Tapu Lele
786.Pokedex: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

787.Name: Tapu Bulu
787.Pokedex: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it leeches energy from the creatures it attracts.

788.Name: Tapu Fini
788.Pokedex: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

789.Name: Cosmog
789.Pokedex: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It is said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

790.Name: Cosmoem
790.Pokedex: The shell that encases it is harder than any known material. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

791.Name: Solgaleo
791.Pokedex: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

792.Name: Lunala
792.Pokedex: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

793.Name: Nihilego
793.Pokedex: Producing a strong neurotoxin, those infested by it suddenly become violent. Sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

794.Name: Buzzwole
794.Pokedex: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

795.Name: Pheromosa
795.Pokedex: One of the Ultra Beasts. It only touches things to get rid of them, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

796.Name: Xurkitree
796.Pokedex: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

797.Name: Celesteela
797.Pokedex: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

798.Name: Kartana
798.Pokedex: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

799.Name: Guzzlord
799.Pokedex: Gobbling mountains and swallowing whole buildings, it appears to be eating constantly. Yet its droppings have never been found.

800.Name: Necrozma
800.Pokedex: Light is the source of its energy. If it is not devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.

801.Name: Magearna
801.Pokedex: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

802.Name: Marshadow
802.Pokedex: It causes people to despair wherever it goes. Saddened by this, it usually hides in the shadows and never appears.

803.Name: Poipole
803.Pokedex: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

804.Name: Naganadel
804.Pokedex: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

805.Name: Stakataka
805.Pokedex: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

806.Name: Blacephalon
806.Pokedex: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It is apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

807.Name: Zeraora
807.Pokedex: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

808.Name: Rattata
808.Pokedex: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

809.Name: Raticate
809.Pokedex: It has an incredibly greedy personality. Its nest is filled with more food gathered by the Rattata at its direction than it could possibly eat.

810.Name: A-Raichu
810.Pokedex: It focuses psychic energy into its tail to lift it. It then rides it like it's surfing!

811.Name: A-Sandshrew
811.Pokedex: Its ice-covered body lets it slide across the ground with bullet-like speed, sending its enemies flying when it hits them.

812.Name: A-Sandslash
812.Pokedex: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

813.Name: A-Vulpix
813.Pokedex: They live together in a skulk, helping one another. Before eating their prey, they freeze it solid with their –58 degree Fahrenheit breath.

814.Name: A-Ninetales
814.Pokedex: Some said that deities visited mountains where Ninetales live, so in times long past, no one was allowed to go into those mountains.

815.Name: A-Diglett
815.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

816.Name: A-Dugtrio
816.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

817.Name: Hippopolush
817.Pokedex: Hippopolush loves to splash around, but somehow still thrives in hot, arid deserts. It is viewed as instrumental in many desert ecosystems.

818.Name: Hippoasis
818.Pokedex: Hippoasis produces plant life and water, allowing many desert species to survive that would otherwise be unable to.

819.Name: A-Geodude
819.Pokedex: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

820.Name: A-Graveler
820.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

821.Name: A-Golem
821.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

822.Name: Tarountula
822.Pokedex: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

823.Name: Spidops
823.Pokedex: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before they even notice.

824.Name: A-Exeggutor
824.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers while within it awakened a sleeping dragon.

825.Name: A-Marowak
825.Pokedex: When it beats opponents with its bone, the cursed flames spread to them. No amount of water will stop those flames from burning.

826.Name: Zygarde-10%
826.Pokedex: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

827.Name: Lycanroc
827.Pokedex: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. When it attacks, does so without reservation.

828.Name: Lycanroc
828.Pokedex: Bathed in the setting sun of dusk, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its cold expression.

829.Name: Santadelie
829.Pokedex: Once a year, it gives gifts to children from a magical sleigh pulled by flying Stantler.

830.Name: Chemera
830.Pokedex: It is in agony when inside a Pokeball. Researchers speculate that this is a result of Chemera being composed primarily of corrupted Pokeball data.

831.Name: Alkaboros
831.Pokedex: Being so acclimated to pain makes Alkaboros a horrifyingly difficult opponent. That, and its fiery, oozing, nightmarish body, of course.

832.Name: Muskoat
832.Pokedex: They live in herds in the tundra. When threatened, they spin up a poisonous chemical that can be spit out or even secreted. This turns its fur purple.

833.Name: Musktox
833.Pokedex: Large herbivores that live in the tundra. They have long lived in harmony with humans, but their poisonous secretions make them difficult to domesticate.

834.Name: Boreaptor
834.Pokedex: These former jungle hunters, after surviving an ice age, have now acclimated themselves exclusively to colder regions.

835.Name: Velocicle
835.Pokedex: It has an entire arsenal of weapons that make it a lethal predator, from its spined whip-like tail to its icy fangs and venomous claws.

836.Name: Claycotta
836.Pokedex: Long ago, a great Emperor created an army of Claycotta to wage war against all of the known world.

837.Name: Claymord
837.Pokedex: Natural leaders, these Pokemon were once commanders in an army that waged war against all of the known world.

838.Name: Korvia
838.Pokedex: They care deeply for their friends. Inexperienced as knights, Korvia can be a bit overzealous in charging into battle or overprotecting their trainer.

839.Name: Impugil
839.Pokedex: A Pokemon once renowned for kindness, diabolical experiments to remove its Fairy typing have distorted it into a fiend.

840.Name: Diabollyon
840.Pokedex: The most deplorable and wicked of Pokemon, horrific experiments have contorted it into an irredeemably twisted monster.

841.Name: Valkyrok
841.Pokedex: These warrior spirits are said to have saved the Telius region from foreign invaders in a great war long ago.

842.Name: Flaminquent
842.Pokedex: It has a brash and difficult attitude, convinced it always knows best. It is known to form troublemaking gangs with Pokemon like Scraggy.

843.Name: Scimenco
843.Pokedex: It is cocky and vicious. It dances around to draw attention to itself, but meet its gaze and it may suddenly and violently attack you!

844.Name: Mindigo
844.Pokedex: The body is just a vessel for the mask. It's said that the mask houses three evil spirits constantly fighting for control of the vessel.

845.Name: Wendraugr
845.Pokedex: The spirit of a mindless necrophage that wrestles for control of the bodies of Mindigo. The vessel it possesses becomes a disgusting, insatiable monster.

846.Name: Wendrifr
846.Pokedex: The spirit of a demented wizard that wrestles for control of the bodies of Mindigo. The vessel it possesses becomes a disfigured, manic necromancer.

847.Name: Wendreavr
847.Pokedex: The spirit of an elemental essence that wrestles for control of the bodies of Mindigo. The vessel it possesses becomes a malicious, serpentine djinn.

848.Name: Bamboozle
848.Pokedex: An utterly bizarre and unpredictable trickster, this Pokemon totters around aimlessly. If it invites you to play a game, you should politely decline.

849.Name: Parastrain
849.Pokedex: The fungi has become a wretched hivemind, part of the same life form as the bug body. The grim visage of its spores and pincers shake even the bravest souls.

850.Name: Aristeroth
850.Pokedex: A phantom created when there is a failed heroic effort. It seeks to regain its lost memories through contact with opponents' struggles.

851.Name: Meltan
851.Pokedex: Failed attempts at resurrecting the legendary Pokemon Melmetal eventually resulted in the creation of this species.

852.Name: Melmetal
852.Pokedex: It was used over 3000 years ago to create metals. Modern technology revived it, but with a liquefied, toxic body.

853.Name: Moaidea
853.Pokedex: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Moaidea's face contained a mysterious power.

854.Name: Graffitiki
854.Pokedex: Ancient people of the Alola Region despised Graffitiki for bringing sun that would destroy their crops. This is apparently no longer a problem, however.

855.Name: Harprey
855.Pokedex: An intelligent apex predator, humans fear its piercing shrieks. It traps prey, using its barbed leg talons to envenom and haul off young Bouffalant.

856.Name: Alphanonymus
856.Pokedex: Unown resonance with modified Odd Keystones created this composite being. Further testing is required on this strange new variant.

857.Name: Regaledy
857.Pokedex: It holds pure moonlight in its crown. With an iron fist, it rules over and preserves all clean forests.

858.Name: Terachnitas
858.Pokedex: Its heart seeks chaos and upheaval. Mustering other foul, creeping things, it brings to ruin all that is ordered.

859.Name: Colosswhal
859.Pokedex: One of the rarest non-legendary Pokemon, some explore vast oceans seeking the mystical power their horns supposedly hold.

860.Name: Divapason
860.Pokedex: A true ice queen, this dramatic Pokemon strikes both fear and awe with its sad, melodic cries and powerful wintry blasts.

861.Name: Aetherhine
861.Pokedex: Living miles underground, this Pokémon is one of the rarest to find in the wild. Researchers claim it is somehow integral to the planet's health.

862.Name: Caracoldron
862.Pokedex: Caracoldron can live for hundreds of years despite struggling to store energy. Instead, they erupt or hail meteors down for metabolic regulation.

863.Name: Cascora
863.Pokedex: Cascora are instrumental to the health of the seas. Scientists have tried to augment them for use in water treatment facilities.

864.Name: Distortree
864.Pokedex: Chemical manipulations have allowed this Pokemon to exhibit plant-like traits including pebble-like seeds and bark as hard as stone.

865.Name: Cloisine
865.Pokedex: Augmented by strange DNA, it works tirelessly in food industries. Strangely, it has developed a rapacious appetite for Fairy-type Pokemon.

866.Name: Cherraphim
866.Pokedex: It can manipulate solar energy. Passionate in everything it does, it most loves joyful celebrations and scourging evildoers.

867.Name: Carillona
867.Pokedex: Its bells resonate with various energy waves. Mostly uncontrollable, its tendency to disrupt telecommunication networks gives it a mischievous reputation.

868.Name: Tentakraken
868.Pokedex: Eldritch stories of the deep; pulsing red lights from the abyss... Its dreadful tentacles and energy blasts are the horror of all waters.

869.Name: Veisstacean
869.Pokedex: Very little is known about it. Researchers who dare venture deep within the icy crevasses where it dwells are never seen again.

870.Name: Seraphair
870.Pokedex: Historical records indicate that because Seraphair can read the intents of others, it arbitrated entire societies with its verdicts.

871.Name: Vesupius
871.Pokedex: Their cocoons are made of magma. They absorb nutrients from the earth and sun until they have enough energy for evolution.

872.Name: Citrusaur
872.Pokedex: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

873.Name: Canoplethio
873.Pokedex: The process of creating Canoplethio was completely revolutionary, hardening Tropius's immune and skeletal systems with DNA splicing.

874.Name: Scarlacia
874.Pokedex: Mystical properties attributed to Flygon are actually the work of this Pokemon, which disappears into sandstorms until its body returns to sand itself.

875.Name: Bisheerie
875.Pokedex: It appears their spirits were preserved in fossils instead of their eel-like bodies. But with enough dead tissue, they can materialize.

876.Name: Solstwins
876.Pokedex: Solstwins was once worshipped by Amokkins as the avatar of the dual-gods Gronia and Swamki. It's widely recognized as a religious symbol.

877.Name: Nihilight
877.Pokedex: This Pokemon maintains the cycles of human grief through denial, bargaining, and acceptance. It is highly intelligent and talks to humans through electromagnetic pulses.

878.Name: Druidem
878.Pokedex: This Pokemon maintains the cycles of nature through light, soil, and nutrients. It is highly intelligent and talks to nature through ley lines.

879.Name: Immortelius
879.Pokedex: Their cocoons are made of magma. They absorb nutrients from the earth and sun until they have enough energy for evolution.

880.Name: H. Avalugg
880.Pokedex: This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow. Sometimes other Pokemon hitch a ride on its back!

882.Name: Mosqewer
882.Pokedex: Its long needle mouth can pierce bones and suck out their marrow. The abdominal blood sac is far less vulnerable than it looks.

883.Name: Scarecroach
883.Pokedex: This terrifying Pokemon is actually possessed by a hivemind of bugs which control the movements and actions of the scarecrow body.

884.Name: Cramorant
884.Pokedex: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

885.Name: Motocyclops
885.Pokedex: Famous songs have been written of fools who ghost ride this whip: they are driven straight down the highway to hell!

886.Name: Orchestrum
886.Pokedex: It's said that the power of a long-lost song stirred this Pokemon to life. It always keeps perfect time.

887.Name: Mr. Rime
887.Pokedex: Its amusing routine makes it very popular. But when in battle, its performance usually means its opponents are the ones that break a leg!

888.Name: Swashlocker
888.Pokedex: Yo-ho, yo-ho, a Pokemon holding a gun! Yo-ho, yo-ho; why is the rum always gone?

889.Name: Sphincubus
889.Pokedex: Capable of speech, scientists believe these puzzling statues were used as hosts by a seemingly sentient primordial virus.

890.Name: Meowstic
890.Pokedex: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

891.Name: Zamazenta
891.Pokedex: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

892.Name: Shockra
892.Pokedex: Its mysterious origins are tied to Amokkin legends, but some rumors claim it was created by PokeStar Studios in the Unova Region.

893.Name: Forgiant
893.Pokedex: These leviathans of the deep form their own Pokemon societies through their unmatched creative and organizational power.

894.Name: Platytuudz
894.Pokedex: Its impressive bulk belies its incredibly quirky and humorous personality. Multitudes of trainers are drawn to it because of its joyful idiosyncrasies.

895.Name: Sepulchrest
895.Pokedex: Featured in ancient Amokkin heraldry, this bird-like spirit prophesies the death of the sun and the end of the world.

896.Name: Anubrakhan
896.Pokedex: Its appearance is dignified. This 'taskmaster of the sands' will dominate the weak and ambush the strong.

897.Name: Frospire
897.Pokedex: Synthesized by humans, its partly organic composition can be used to both provide shelter in and directly aid in the study of harsh climates.

898.Name: Morpeko
898.Pokedex: Hormones completely warp its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

899.Name: Basculegion
899.Pokedex: Basculegion spawns from the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.

901.Name: Alltross
901.Pokedex: Believing its own experiential and revelatory knowledge to be supreme, it is locked in eternal bloodshed with Nephilamia and Parallaxon.

902.Name: Nephilamia
902.Pokedex: Believing its own disciplined and creative traditions to be supreme, it is locked in eternal bloodshed with Alltross and Parallaxon.

903.Name: Parallaxon
903.Pokedex: Believing its perpetually updating technological faculties to be supreme, it is locked in eternal bloodshed with Alltross and Nephilamia.

904.Name: G-Darumaka
904.Pokedex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

905.Name: G-Darmanitan
905.Pokedex: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.

906.Name: Purrzurker
906.Pokedex: Purrzurker would form tribes to raid and plunder human towns together. Now, however, they seem only interested in attacking other Pokemon.

907.Name: Deerling
907.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

908.Name: Sawsbuck
908.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

909.Name: Deerling
909.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

910.Name: Sawsbuck
910.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

911.Name: Deerling
911.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

912.Name: Sawsbuck
912.Pokedex: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

913.Name: Grookey
913.Pokedex: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

914.Name: Thwackey
914.Pokedex: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

915.Name: Rillaboom
915.Pokedex: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

916.Name: Scorbunny
916.Pokedex: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

917.Name: Raboot
917.Pokedex: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

918.Name: Cinderace
918.Pokedex: Lightning quick, it maneuvers a ball with its feet. Its strikes are hard and precise and leave arcs of sparks in their wake.

919.Name: Sobble
919.Pokedex: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

920.Name: Drizzile
920.Pokedex: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

921.Name: Inteleon
921.Pokedex: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

922.Name: Skwovet
922.Pokedex: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll crawl into people's homes, searching for yet more berries.

923.Name: Greedent
923.Pokedex: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

924.Name: Rookidee
924.Pokedex: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

925.Name: Corvisquire
925.Pokedex: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

926.Name: Corviknight
926.Pokedex: This Pokémon regins supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

927.Name: Blipbug
927.Pokedex: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

928.Name: Dottler
928.Pokedex: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

929.Name: Orbeetle
929.Pokedex: It emits impressive psychic energy from its gigantic brain center to observe and study everything around it, up to six miles away.

930.Name: Nickit
930.Pokedex: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off of its ill-gotten gains.

931.Name: Thievul
931.Pokedex: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

932.Name: Gossifleur
932.Pokedex: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

933.Name: Edelgoss
933.Pokedex: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

934.Name: Wooloo
934.Pokedex: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

935.Name: Dubwool
935.Pokedex: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

936.Name: Chewtle
936.Pokedex: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

937.Name: Drednaw
937.Pokedex: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

938.Name: Yamper
938.Pokedex: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

939.Name: Boltund
939.Pokedex: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltound can run nonstop for three full days.

940.Name: Rolycoly
940.Pokedex: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

941.Name: Carkol
941.Pokedex: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

942.Name: Coalossus
942.Pokedex: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

943.Name: Applin
943.Pokedex: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

944.Name: Flapple
944.Pokedex: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. It flies on wings of apple skin and can also change its shape into that of an apple.

945.Name: Appletun
945.Pokedex: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in Pokémon it preys on.

946.Name: Silicobra
946.Pokedex: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

947.Name: Sandaconda
947.Pokedex: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

948.Name: Eternatus
948.Pokedex: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

949.Name: G-Ponyta
949.Pokedex: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

950.Name: G-Rapidash
950.Pokedex: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

951.Name: Grunjam
951.Pokedex: It manipulates its chemical makeup to produce electricity. The voltage may be low, but the protrusions on its head work like speakers!

952.Name: Charismuse
952.Pokedex: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

953.Name: Sizzlipede
953.Pokedex: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

954.Name: Centiskorch
954.Pokedex: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

955.Name: Clobbopus
955.Pokedex: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

956.Name: Grapploct
956.Pokedex: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

957.Name: Sinistea
957.Pokedex: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

958.Name: Polteageist
958.Pokedex: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

959.Name: Snymph
959.Pokedex: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

960.Name: Snowhim
960.Pokedex: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

961.Name: Sylphlake
961.Pokedex: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Silent Witch.

962.Name: Impidimp
962.Pokedex: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

963.Name: Morgrem
963.Pokedex: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, its trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

964.Name: Grimmsnarl
964.Pokedex: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

965.Name: Obstagoon
965.Pokedex: Notorious for seedy underworld dealings, it relies mostly on its wits and intimidation. Disreputable trainers use it as an enforcer.

966.Name: Cursola
966.Pokedex: After its environment was polluted, this once vibrant and vivacious Pokémon is now a ghostly shell of its former self.

967.Name: Curscora
967.Pokedex: Be cautious of its toxic, ectoplasmic body. Its pollutants are said to blight everything around it.

968.Name: Sirfetch'd
968.Pokedex: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

969.Name: Ingast
969.Pokedex: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when a vengeful spirit was drawn to an ancient clay tablet.

970.Name: Deildolon
970.Pokedex: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

971.Name: Milcery
971.Pokedex: This Pokémon sweetens foul-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

972.Name: Alcremie
972.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

973.Name: Phalinks
973.Pokedex: Five of these tenacious warriors are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

974.Name: Pincurchin
974.Pokedex: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

975.Name: Snom
975.Pokedex: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

976.Name: Frosmoth
976.Pokedex: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

977.Name: Stonjourner
977.Pokedex: Once a year at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle. It is rumored they create rifts between worlds.

979.Name: Kubfu
979.Pokedex: Protected by its family unit, Kubfu's uncultivated Wushu energy is an irresistable food source for predatory Ultra Beasts.

980.Name: Urshifu
980.Pokedex: Inhabiting the mountains of a strange land, this Pokémon hones its alien Wushu powers to slay the beasts and monsters that threaten its livelihood.

981.Name: Cufant
981.Pokedex: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

982.Name: Copperajah
982.Pokedex: Copperajah's trunk has incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder. Their green skin is resistant to water.

983.Name: Duraludon
983.Pokedex: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's lightweight, strong, and considerably agile. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

984.Name: Dreepy
984.Pokedex: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

985.Name: Drakloak
985.Pokedex: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

986.Name: Dragapult
986.Pokedex: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

987.Name: Zacian
987.Pokedex: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

988.Name: Lycanroc
988.Pokedex: Bathed in the breaking light of dawn, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An ascetic poise underlies its cheery demeanor.

989.Name: Alcremie
989.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

990.Name: Alcremie
990.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

991.Name: Alcremie
991.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

992.Name: Alcremie
992.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

993.Name: Alcremie
993.Pokedex: Make sure to treat this Pokemon well! When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

994.Name: Thermolt
994.Pokedex: It regulates convection currents beneath the earth's surface. Its metal body is partially melted by its own heat.

995.Name: Wattrel
995.Pokedex: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

996.Name: GRD Barbaracle
996.Pokedex: A fallen Pokémon resurrected with the essence of Regirock. Pieces of its loathesome, rugged body chip off and impede its enemies.

997.Name: Kilowattrel
997.Pokedex: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

998.Name: G-Weezing
998.Pokedex: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

999.Name: Gritagonist
999.Pokedex: Gather your party! The fearless leader of this quest, Gritagonist heroically fights for its friends no matter the odds!

1000.Name: Rivivory
