1000.Pokedex: Gather your party! The healer of this quest, Rivivory tends to every need of the others, be it physical, mental, or spiritual!

1001.Name: Persebony
1001.Pokedex: Gather your party! The mage of this quest, Persebony's insight, knowledge, and diverse magics will be needed at every turn!

1002.Name: Wardraide
1002.Pokedex: Gather your party! The muscle of this quest, Wardraide brings valuable connections and serious brawn to any encounter!

1003.Name: Barralvo
1003.Pokedex: Gather your party! The warrior of this quest, Barralvo is here to have a blast--with lots of laughing and explosions!

1004.Name: Familiore
1004.Pokedex: Gather your party! The specialist of this quest, Familiore is funny, quirky, and unique! Who knows what it may have in store!

1005.Name: Tantamat
1005.Pokedex: Gather your party! The rogue of this quest, don't let Tantamat's bag of tricks and lethal precision take you by surprise!

1006.Name: GRD Girafarig
1006.Pokedex: A fallen Pokémon resurrected with the essence of Raikou. The rapidity of its flashing movements causes bouts of seizures.

1007.Name: Knitterbug
1007.Pokedex: Surprisingly durable for having a cloth exoskeleton, this cute specter pretends to be a plush doll before surprise attacking prey.

1008.Name: Crawstitch
1008.Pokedex: No one knows what it looks like beneath its endless layers of cloth. If you ever fully unravel it, it will suck out your very soul!

1009.Name: Destineedle
1009.Pokedex: It thrives in cold, dark environments. After incapacitating prey, it sews its helpless victims into caricatures which decorate its lair.

1010.Name: Ankylure
1010.Pokedex: Lying beneath loose sand or mud, they bait unsuspecting prey to their demise. The nodes on its carapace are not defensive but rather work as barometers.

1011.Name: Farfarato
1011.Pokedex: Farfarato's wings capture stories of their trainers like photographs, tinting the memories based on whether or not it remembers them fondly.

1012.Name: Calyrex
1012.Pokedex: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over places uninhabited by humans. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

1013.Name: G-Slowpoke
1013.Pokedex: Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.

1014.Name: G-Slowbro
1014.Pokedex: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the shell on its arm, it will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

1015.Name: G-Slowking
1015.Pokedex: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange concoctions.

1016.Name: Lechonk
1016.Pokedex: It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging. It makes an excellent spit roast.

1017.Name: Oinkologne
1017.Pokedex: This meticulous Pokémon only uses mud for spa treatments. It even shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

1018.Name: Nymble
1018.Pokedex: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

1019.Name: Lokix
1019.Pokedex: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

1020.Name: Pawmot
1020.Pokedex: This Pokémon is incredibly quick to react, happy to enter battle and then strike down enemies with lightning-fast movements.

1021.Name: Tandemaus
1021.Pokedex: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

1022.Name: Maushold
1022.Pokedex: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating, playing, and sleeping.

1023.Name: Fidough
1023.Pokedex: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces misty fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

1024.Name: Fuedough
1024.Pokedex: When exposed to heat, this Pokémon's skin shimmers and yields an appetizing aroma. Otherwise, hope you like the smell of fermenting yeast!

1025.Name: Nacli
1025.Pokedex: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

1026.Name: Naclstack
1026.Pokedex: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

1027.Name: Garganacl
1027.Pokedex: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

1028.Name: Charcadet
1028.Pokedex: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

1029.Name: Armarouge
1029.Pokedex: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

1030.Name: Ceruledge
1030.Pokedex: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

1031.Name: Shroodle
1031.Pokedex: A mellow Pokémon, it keeps enemies away from its territory by painting markings around its nest using an acrid, poisonous liquid.

1032.Name: Lemural
1032.Pokedex: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Lemural covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

1033.Name: Bramblin
1033.Pokedex: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

1034.Name: Brambleghast
1034.Pokedex: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

1035.Name: Capsakid
1035.Pokedex: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

1036.Name: Scovillain
1036.Pokedex: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

1037.Name: Scaraglob
1037.Pokedex: It rolls its pristine snow ball around to stimulate life energy. It treasures its ball more than its own life.

1038.Name: Reincarab
1038.Pokedex: There is some kind of miraculous life essence inside its snow globe. Day and night, Reincarab rolls this globe soothingly with its legs.

1039.Name: Flittle
1039.Pokedex: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

1040.Name: Espathra
1040.Pokedex: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

1041.Name: Tinkatink
1041.Pokedex: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

1042.Name: Tinkatuff
1042.Pokedex: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

1043.Name: Tinkaton
1043.Pokedex: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

1044.Name: Bombirdier
1044.Pokedex: Bombirdier eats minerals, the byproducts of which are processed and then stored in its chest apron. When it has a full payload, watch out!

1045.Name: Finizen
1045.Pokedex: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

1046.Name: Palafin
1046.Pokedex: This Pokémon can change into an alter ego if it hears its allies calling for help, but will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

1047.Name: Varoom
1047.Pokedex: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

1048.Name: Revavroom
1048.Pokedex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders--now numbering eight--to generate energy.

1049.Name: Cyclizar
1049.Pokedex: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

1050.Name: Glimmet
1050.Pokedex: It absorbs minerals, but isn't good at regulating its internal energy. If overloaded, it will discharge deadly energy beams.

1051.Name: Glimmora
1051.Pokedex: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized energy. In battle, it will open these up and fire beams from its conical body.

1052.Name: Greavard
1052.Pokedex: This Pokémon is undyingly vigilant and obedient. Its reliable candle lights up while on duty after being given an order.

1053.Name: Barroward
1053.Pokedex: Barroward spends most of its time keeping watch in graveyards with only its head protuberance exposed. Among all Pokémon, this one is most loyal.

1054.Name: Cetoddle
1054.Pokedex: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

1055.Name: Cetitan
1055.Pokedex: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

1056.Name: Annihilape
1056.Pokedex: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

1057.Name: Farigiraf
1057.Pokedex: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

1058.Name: Kingambit
1058.Pokedex: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

1059.Name: Frigibax
1059.Pokedex: Using the power of its energy-storing dorsal fin, Frigibax cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

1060.Name: Arctibax
1060.Pokedex: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

1061.Name: Excelsius
1061.Pokedex: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

1062.Name: Gimmigoon
1062.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

1063.Name: Smoliv
1063.Pokedex: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

1064.Name: Dolliv
1064.Pokedex: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

1065.Name: Arboliva
1065.Pokedex: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash boulders.

1066.Name: Wo-Chien
1066.Pokedex: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

1067.Name: Chien-Pao
1067.Pokedex: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

1068.Name: Ting-Lu
1068.Pokedex: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

1069.Name: Chi-Yu
1069.Pokedex: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

1070.Name: Koraidon
1070.Pokedex: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

1071.Name: Miraidon
1071.Pokedex: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

1072.Name: GRD Scyther
1072.Pokedex: A fallen Pokémon resurrected with the essence of Regice. Its sharp glass body is seemingly unassailable.

1073.Name: GRD Hitmonlee
1073.Pokedex: A fallen Pokémon resurrected with the essence of Registeel. The elasticity of its body makes its actions highly irregular and unpredictable.

1074.Name: Obliveon
1074.Pokedex: What looks like bandages is actually part of an extended skeletal system. Its body requires maintenance to prevent it from decaying.

1075.Name: Papilleon
1075.Pokedex: It possesses 3 stomachs, a chitinous exoskeleton in addition to a bone skeleton, 2 small brains in its antennae, and 4 fashionable booties!

1076.Name: Titaneon
1076.Pokedex: Its futuristic skin has a built-in A.I. system that optimizes its muscular and cardio-vascular performance. There are occasional errors, however.

1077.Name: Vigilanteon
1077.Pokedex: It has unshakeable convictions. It yields to no one, and will not be reasoned with while pursuing what it believes must be done.

AEGISLASH_1.Name: Aegislash (Blade Form)
AEGISLASH_1.Pokedex: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.

GIMMIGOON_1.Name: Gimmigoon (Roaming Form)
GIMMIGOON_1.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

XERNEAS_1.Name: Xerneas (Active Mode)
XERNEAS_1.Pokedex: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

ZYGARDE_1.Name: Zygarde-50% (Complete Forme)
ZYGARDE_1.Pokedex: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

ORICORIO_1.Name: Oricorio (Pom-Pom Style)
ORICORIO_1.Pokedex: It lifts its opponents' spirits with its cheerful dance moves. When they let their guard down, it electrocutes them with a jolt.

ORICORIO_2.Name: Oricorio (Pa'u Style)
ORICORIO_2.Pokedex: It relaxes opponents with its rhythmic dancing. When they let their guard down, it crushes them with tectonic energy.

ORICORIO_3.Name: Oricorio (Sensu Style)
ORICORIO_3.Pokedex: It charms its opponents with its refined dancing. When they let their guard down, it places a curse on them that will bring on their demise.

OGERPON_1.Name: Ogerpon (Wild Mask)
OGERPON_1.Pokedex: This form is the most aggressive, building up and venting compressed air.

OGERPON_2.Name: Ogerpon (Stark Mask)
OGERPON_2.Pokedex: This form is the most nimble, seamless and striking in its polarizing design.

OGERPON_3.Name: Ogerpon (Mantle Mask)
OGERPON_3.Pokedex: This form is the most protective, absorbing impacts with a warm embrace.

OGERPON_4.Name: Ogerpon (Current Mask)
OGERPON_4.Pokedex: This form is the most balanced, regulating itself with alternating energy.

WISHIWASHI_1.Name: Wishiwashi (Solo Form)
WISHIWASHI_1.Pokedex: It is awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. Be careful that it doesn't group up into a school, though!

MINIOR_1.Pokedex: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.

CRAMORANT_1.Name: Cramorant (Gorging Form)
CRAMORANT_1.Pokedex: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

ARMAROUGE_1.Name: Armarouge (Ceruledge Form)
ARMAROUGE_1.Pokedex: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

CERULEDGE_1.Name: Ceruledge (Armarouge Form)
CERULEDGE_1.Pokedex: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

MIMIKYU_1.Name: Mimikyu (Busted Form)
MIMIKYU_1.Pokedex: It stands in front of a mirror, trying to fix its broken neck as if its life depended on it. It has a hard time getting it right, so it's crying inside.

SOLGALEO_1.Name: Solgaleo (Radiant Sun Phase)
SOLGALEO_1.Pokedex: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

LUNALA_1.Name: Lunala (Full Moon Phase)
LUNALA_1.Pokedex: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

NECROZMA_1.Name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
NECROZMA_1.Pokedex: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

NECROZMA_2.Name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
NECROZMA_2.Pokedex: This is its form while it's devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps foes in its giant claws and rips them apart with brute force.

NECROZMA_3.Name: Ultra Necrozma
NECROZMA_3.Pokedex: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

MAGEARNA_1.Name: Magearna (Original Color)
MAGEARNA_1.Pokedex: This is its form from almost 500 years ago. Its body is nothing more than a container—its artificial heart is the actual life-form.

CALYREX_1.Name: Calyrex (Ice Rider)
CALYREX_1.Pokedex: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that it bonded with ran all across the world to bring peace and prosperity to the Pokemon world.

CALYREX_2.Name: Calyrex (Shadow Rider)
CALYREX_2.Pokedex: It's said that Calyrex and a Pokémon that it bonded with ran all across the world to bring peace and prosperity to the Pokemon world.

GRUNJAM_1.Name: Grunjam (Low Key)
GRUNJAM_1.Pokedex: It manipulates its chemical makeup to produce electricity. The voltage may be low, but the protrusions on its head work like speakers!

CHARISMUSE_1.Name: Charismuse (Low Key)
CHARISMUSE_1.Pokedex: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

BANETTE_1.Name: Mega Banette
BANETTE_1.Pokedex: Overwhelming energy causes corruption to leak out of its body. Its own Trainer can even succumb to the negative effects of its curses.

MACHAMP_1.Name: Mega Machamp
MACHAMP_1.Pokedex: It has gained considerable height and athleticism. Its power-infused hands cannot stop shaking, however...

ALAKAZAM_1.Name: Mega Alakazam
ALAKAZAM_1.Pokedex: It sends out psychic power from the red organ on its forehead to predict movement. Its migraines eventually induce seizures and stroke.

GENGAR_1.Name: Mega Gengar
GENGAR_1.Pokedex: It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!

KANGASKHAN_1.Name: Mega Kangaskhan
KANGASKHAN_1.Pokedex: The explosive energy stimulates temporary growth in the child. Repeated exposure risks devastating long-term health concerns.

STANTLER_1.Name: Mega Stantler
STANTLER_1.Pokedex: Its eerily white fur is painful to touch and has been linked to increased cancer rates in trainers exposed to it.

GYARADOS_1.Name: Mega Gyarados
GYARADOS_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution continuously agitates its now-swollen body. Trainers attempting to control it have ended up maimed or worse.

AERODACTYL_1.Name: Mega Aerodactyl
AERODACTYL_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution heightens its aggression, resilience, maneuverability, and predatory instincts, but shortens its lifespan.

MEWTWO_1.Name: Mega Mewtwo
MEWTWO_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution streamlined its body and agitated its psychic abilities to uncontrollable levels. It can stop a heart with a mere thought.

AMPHAROS_1.Name: Mega Ampharos
AMPHAROS_1.Pokedex: Excess energy causes the wool it lost to grow in again. Maintaining this form for too long, however, will cause the light in its tail to go out.

SCIZOR_1.Name: Mega Scizor
SCIZOR_1.Pokedex: Unable to properly cool itself, it slowly melts away in pain. It dismembers opponents with its horrific sawblade arms.

HOUNDOOM_1.Name: Mega Houndoom
HOUNDOOM_1.Pokedex: Houndoom's entire body generates heat, painful to even itself. Its fearsome black breath consumes opponents, body and soul.

GARDEVOIR_1.Name: Mega Gardevoir
GARDEVOIR_1.Pokedex: One of the more stable Mega Evolutions, Gardevoir manipulates the excess energy into an aura around it. Keeping it up for long is still exhausting, though.

MAWILE_1.Name: Mega Mawile
MAWILE_1.Pokedex: It has an extremely vicious disposition. It grips prey in its two sets of steel jaws and tears them apart with animalistic ferocity.

AGGRON_1.Name: Mega Aggron
AGGRON_1.Pokedex: Its body and mind are augmented into an unstoppable war machine. But once it reverts and sees the destruction it has caused, it weeps bitterly.

MEDICHAM_1.Name: Mega Medicham
MEDICHAM_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution brings Medicham's physical, mental, and spiritual energy into nirvana. It attempts to make humans subservient to it.

TESLIGER_1.Name: Mega Tesliger
TESLIGER_1.Pokedex: Its plasma coil acts as a muzzle, maiming Tesliger as it bores endlessly through the ground. Mega Evolution drives it onward and onward and onward.

ABSOL_1.Name: Mega Absol
ABSOL_1.Pokedex: Although powerful and majestic, it hates changing to this form and being forced to battle. Its kind resents humans even more as a result.

LUCARIO_1.Name: Mega Lucario
LUCARIO_1.Pokedex: Its aura has diminished due to Mega Evolution. Governed only by its combative instincts, it quickly finds weaknesses and strikes without mercy.

ABOMASNOW_1.Name: Mega Abomasnow
ABOMASNOW_1.Pokedex: It despises being forced to battle in this form because it becomes primally savage. It perpetually launches avalanches until it's exhausted.

BEEDRILL_1.Name: Mega Beedrill
BEEDRILL_1.Pokedex: Its legs have become poison stingers. It will stab at anything, even its own Trainer, continuing to attack even after its target's fainted.

BUTTERFREE_1.Name: Mega Butterfree
BUTTERFREE_1.Pokedex: Its eyes and wings have become part of its complex neural system. Despite its large wings, it avoids flying because of how painful it is.

PIDGEOT_1.Name: Mega Pidgeot
PIDGEOT_1.Pokedex: With its strength and brutality greatly increased, it will whip up powerful blasts of wind with even the slightest flap of its wings.

STEELIX_1.Name: Mega Steelix
STEELIX_1.Pokedex: The nearly unbearable pressure from Mega Evolution caused parts of its body to erupt and harden. These parts are illegal to buy or sell.

LANTURN_1.Name: Mega Lanturn
LANTURN_1.Pokedex: Energy from Mega Evolution causes destructive light to pour out of it. The light eventually starts poking holes through its own body.

FERROCKET_1.Name: Mega Ferrocket
FERROCKET_1.Pokedex: Parts of its floofy body have begun to spontaneously combust. Maintaining this form for too long will leave grim-smelling ashes.

SABLEYE_1.Name: Mega Sableye
SABLEYE_1.Pokedex: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expanded, ripped through its skin, and fell out.

SHARPEDO_1.Name: Mega Sharpedo
SHARPEDO_1.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are wounds created by the energy from Mega Evolution. They cause it sharp pain and suffering.

CAMERUPT_1.Name: Mega Camerupt
CAMERUPT_1.Pokedex: Its single hump forms by fusion of its bones. Constantly nauseated, it forcefully jets magma to try and relieve itself.

ALTARIA_1.Name: Mega Altaria
ALTARIA_1.Pokedex: Excess energy continues to generate fluffy clouds around it. It dislikes being in this form because it cannot sing or fly well.

GLALIE_1.Name: Mega Glalie
GLALIE_1.Pokedex: Imbued with tremendous energy, its countenance contorts into a warped, cruel helm. It freezes everything around it.

SALAMENCE_1.Name: Mega Salamence
SALAMENCE_1.Pokedex: Mortified by its body becoming misshapen and stuck together, it will sometimes attempt to harm itself in order to revert.

DONPHAN_1.Name: Mega Donphan
DONPHAN_1.Pokedex: It has reverted to prehistoric size, primal instincts and savage aggression. It is completely unstable and unpredictable.

RAYQUAZA_1.Name: Mega Rayquaza
RAYQUAZA_1.Pokedex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

LOPUNNY_1.Name: Mega Lopunny
LOPUNNY_1.Pokedex: It despises fighting, but this state makes it intensely combative. It quickly becomes manic, lashing out wildly in an attempt to revert.

TOXICROAK_1.Name: Mega Toxicroak
TOXICROAK_1.Pokedex: Chemical overload swells its upper body and sets it on an unstable rampage. Its cackling croak and unnatural shamble make it all the more horrifying.

GALLADE_1.Name: Mega Gallade
GALLADE_1.Pokedex: It has lost its sense of duty and now seeks only challenge. It cuts down the defenseless without a second thought.

AUDINO_1.Name: Mega Audino
AUDINO_1.Pokedex: Originally made in a desperate attempt to save a life, all Audino will feel a sharp sense of loss when forced to take this form.

DIANCIE_1.Name: Mega Diancie
DIANCIE_1.Pokedex: It is said to possess the original energy used for Mega Evolution. No other species can replicate the stability of this Mega form.

OCTILLERY_1.Name: Mega Octillery
OCTILLERY_1.Pokedex: Augmented by biomechanical growth and now spouting fire, its dementedness is only matched by its penchant for destruction.

ROSERADE_1.Name: Mega Roserade
ROSERADE_1.Pokedex: Its elegance belies its insatiable desire to dismember and torture Pokemon and humans alike with its endlessly proliferating thorns.

GARBODOR_1.Name: Mega Garbodor
GARBODOR_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution expanded its ability to produce biomass. Its mind is lost in the churn of ever-expanding piles of rubbish.

COFAGRIGUS_1.Name: Mega Cofagrigus
COFAGRIGUS_1.Pokedex: Energy from Mega Evolution animated the pharaonic mummy inside. In a raving fit, it attempts to force its trainer to perform its will!

MIGHTYENA_1.Name: Mega Mightyena
MIGHTYENA_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution disfigured its skeleton, making Mightyena discolored and misshapen. It gnaws its own protruding bones in agony.

CARNIVINE_1.Name: Mega Carnivine
CARNIVINE_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution enlarged its prey drive. But its anatomy has become monstrous, limiting its mobility as it desperately writhes around.

DRUDDIGON_1.Name: Mega Druddigon
DRUDDIGON_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has hardened its hideous heart, scales and claws into this unsightly subterrane terror.

LAPRAS_1.Name: Mega Lapras
LAPRAS_1.Pokedex: The energy its bathed in has given it a cold heart. It refuses all attempts at human contact or communication.

DRIFBLIM_1.Name: Mega Drifblim
DRIFBLIM_1.Pokedex: Its body has expanded due to energy from Mega Evolution. It gleefully bombards large areas without discrimination.

FROSLASS_1.Name: Mega Froslass
FROSLASS_1.Pokedex: It has woven a meticulous coat out of the bodies of its prey. Its trainer must be incredibly wary around it.

BEARTIC_1.Name: Mega Beartic
BEARTIC_1.Pokedex: This form augments its physiology with excessive muscular growth. It never runs out of energy. Never make direct eye contact.

TAUROS_1.Name: Mega Tauros
TAUROS_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution warped its flesh into a mechanical bull's. Somewhat. Appalled by its augmentation, it thrashes to harm itself as much as others.

SUNFLORA_1.Name: Mega Sunflora
SUNFLORA_1.Pokedex: The energy from Mega Evolution stimulated uncontrollable growth. It scorches everything around with burning hatred until it withers.

RATICATE_1.Name: Mega Raticate
RATICATE_1.Pokedex: Energy originally intended to revive a dead Raticate was eventually used to augment living Raticate into ghoulish fiends.

ARBOK_1.Name: Mega Arbok
ARBOK_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution warped and sharpened its skin, so movement itself is painful. It only writhes more intensely in response.

ARCANINE_1.Name: Mega Arcanine
ARCANINE_1.Pokedex: The noblest of all Mega Pokemon, the immense power surging through it drives it to purge the world of all perceived evils.

SANDACONDA_1.Name: Mega Sandaconda
SANDACONDA_1.Pokedex: Its body spirals in an uncontrollable vortex with such force that it tears up its own flesh. Even when exhausted, it cannot stop.

DREDNAW_1.Name: Mega Drednaw
DREDNAW_1.Pokedex: Due to the warping of its immense gait, it's now forced to stand upright to alleviate the pressure of its own crushing shell.

KINGLER_1.Name: Mega Kingler
KINGLER_1.Pokedex: It is subject to a rabies-like mania in this state, foaming profusely while awkwardly swinging its sickeningly misshapen claw.

VENUSAUR_1.Name: Mega Venusaur
VENUSAUR_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution stimulated massive metabolic growth. Its body can only sustain its excessive bulk and leafage before its heart gives out.

CHARIZARD_1.Name: Mega Charizard
CHARIZARD_1.Pokedex: It flies around like a jet, burning up anything that moves. Completely uncontrollable, it rampages until its body completely gives out.

BLASTOISE_1.Name: Mega Blastoise
BLASTOISE_1.Pokedex: The immense energy flooding into it connected Blastoise's water cannons to its nervous system. Firing the back cannon explodes pain down its spinal cord.

SCEPTILE_1.Name: Mega Sceptile
SCEPTILE_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has changed its normally aloof and caring personality into a cruel, remorseless killer. Trainers must be very cautious around it.

BLAZIKEN_1.Name: Mega Blaziken
BLAZIKEN_1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution drives this Pokémon into a frenzy. It tries to maintain its poise, but can't help but throw itself at opponents until it faints.

SWAMPERT_1.Name: Mega Swampert
SWAMPERT_1.Pokedex: The energy poured into it triggered unnatural muscular growth. The long-term negative effects of this are certain but unquantifiable.

TYRANITAR_1.Name: Mega Tyranitar
TYRANITAR_1.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

METAGROSS_1.Name: Mega Metagross
METAGROSS_1.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel and calculated they become difficult to watch.

GARCHOMP_1.Name: Mega Garchomp
GARCHOMP_1.Pokedex: Its arms and wings melded into something like scythes. Void of any thought but absolute destruction, it rampages on and on.
